examples.zh: 霍华德是一名有天赋的钢琴家。

examples.en: Rose's father was a talented violinist.
examples.zh: 罗斯的父亲是一位天才的小提琴手。

examples.en: She is a talented musician as well as being a photographer.
examples.zh: 她不但是个摄影师而且还是个天才的音乐家。

individual.mnemonic: talent（才能）+ ed（表示形容词）→ 有才能的

pastExamSents.en: Just then Mario remembered his mother's words: "You are talented in cooking."
pastExamSents.zh: 就在这时，马里奥想起了妈妈的话：“你在烹饪方面很有天赋。”

pastExamSents.en: A talented young team from Ireland, the creators of Memory Helper, developed this support app for people with dementia.
pastExamSents.zh: 来自爱尔兰的一个年轻的天才团队，为痴呆症患者开发了一个可以帮助他们的应用软件，记忆助手（Memory Helper）。

pastExamSents.en: Wang Wei (701—761), a highly talented man of the Tang Dynasty, liked playing it in a bamboo forest on nights with moonlight most.
pastExamSents.zh: 唐代才子王维（701-761）最喜欢在有月光的夜晚，在竹林中弹奏。

pastExamSents.en: In the film McFarland, USA, coach White notices some talented runners in his PE class.
pastExamSents.zh: 在美国电影《麦克法兰》中，怀特教练在他的体育课上注意到一些有天赋的跑步者。

pastExamSents.en: Yuan was not only a great scientist but also a talented man.
pastExamSents.zh: 袁先生不仅是一位伟大的科学家，也是一位有才华的人。
